messages.author: 81f1a4912c0b92ec
messages.subject: Latent means of three groups
parts:
Hello everyone,

with the attached approach below, I want to determine the group difference of a latent variable (con) while other parameters are assumed to be equal between groups. This works, but since I have 3 groups (dir), I would like to extend the presented approach to map the differences of groups 2 and 3 to the reference group. Is this possible?

Thank you for help!

#model.4e
model.4e <- '
inkon =~ inkon1 + inkon2+ inkon3
kon =~ kon2 + kon3

#stuctural modell  
inkon ~ diff*dir #dir are 3 groups (cat)
kon ~ dir
'

fit.4e = sem(model.4e, data = data_r, meanstructure=T)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Latent means of three groups
parts: I have 3 groups (dir), I would like to extend the presented approach to map the differences of groups 2 and 3 to the reference group. Is this possible?

lavaan's model.syntax is not a formula object.  You need to create dummy codes in your data.frame, and use those in your syntax. 

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cat.html
